note: Pre-registered before the search ran. The search may only read the dev data; the lockbox is generated from seeds nobody has drawn and is scored exactly once, for the selected config and the R4 baseline. Changing a value here after the search started is a deviation and must be reported.
farDefinition: wrong AUTO lines / all lines, as in the bake-off

dev.select: test side (already read by bakeoff_v3; it is a dev set here, not a holdout)

lockbox.note: D1 cannot be regenerated, so it is not in the lockbox. Gate thresholds are the ones fitted on dev calibration, transferred unchanged.

searchSpace.stage2: coordinate ascent on the weights, step 0.05, from the 3 best stage-1 configs, until no step improves the objective
searchSpace.gate: G1 with sAuto, mMin, agreeMin chosen by Learn-then-Test fixed-sequence testing on calibration (binomial tail p-value, Bonferroni over paths); sFloor then minimizes (asks + in-catalog NEWs) / lines

objective: maximize correct AUTO lines / lines on the dev test side, subject to the dev test side's one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on FAR <= farMax
lockboxReport: R4 as in bakeoff_v3 with its own G1 tuner
